errors.evidence: The line starts at exactly 1200 USD in 2010, not approximately 1160 USD.

errors.text_span: намалява до около 140 USD през 2021 година
errors.evidence: The value for 2021 is approximately 130 USD. The value for 2020 is approximately 140 USD. The description reports an incorrect value for the year 2021.
Describing the rate of change ('at a slower pace') is an interpretation of the line's slope, not a direct description of an explicitly labeled feature.

errors.text_span: В началото на периода стойността е около 1160 USD
errors.evidence: This is a repetition of the error stating the starting value is 1160 USD, when it is clearly 1200 USD on the chart.
The phrase 'is expected to fall' is interpretive language. A neutral description would simply state the value shown for the year 2030, as it is a plotted point.

errors.text_span: Графиката ясно илюстрира значителното намаляване на цената на литиево-йонните батерии за kWh във времето.
errors.evidence: This concluding sentence uses subjective and evaluative language ('ясно илюстрира' - clearly illustrates, 'значителното' - significant), which constitutes interpretation rather than objective description as required by the prompt.
The description fails to mention the legend, which is present below the chart and is labeled 'Цена за USD/KWh'.
